items.name: HUST Special Cubes Open 2017

venue.name: [Huazhong University of Science and Technology](http://english.hust.edu.cn)

items.information: This competition only consists of 5 non-6-axis puzzle events, namely Pyraminx, Skewb, Clock, Square-1 and Megaminx, being complemented with the earlier Wuhan NxN Open 2017 held in the same city.
